'''Krespuckle the Ever-Hungry''' was a [[Leviathan (creature)|Leviathan]]&mdash;a type of gigantic [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] monster&mdash;which was created by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Exiles|exile]] [[Sorzus Syn]]. Syn considered Krespuckle to be her favorite Leviathan and wrote about it in ''[[Book of Sith]]'', a collection of historical writings.<ref name="BoS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Krespuckle the Ever-Hungry was introduced by ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'', a [[2012]] reference book authored by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="BoS" />
